details.description: ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 is the identifier prefix for chat models fine-tuned from the gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 snapshot of OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo, producing ids of the form ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0125:{org}:{suffix}:{id}. This snapshot is the model that OpenAI's plain 'gpt-3.5-turbo' alias currently points to, and OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page already lists gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 itself as 'Deprecated' in its snapshots list; the model has a 16,385-token context window, a 4,096-token max output, and a September 1, 2021 knowledge cutoff. OpenAI is winding down its fine-tuning platform entirely: it is closed to new users, and this base snapshot, along with fine-tuned models built on it, is scheduled to lose API access on October 23, 2026.
advantages: OpenAI's model page lists fine-tuning as a supported feature of GPT-3.5 Turbo, letting customers train the underlying model on their own example prompts and responses.

OpenAI describes supervised fine-tuning, the technique this model supports, as well suited to classification, nuanced translation, generating content in a specific format, and correcting instruction-following failures (OpenAI's supervised fine-tuning guide).
disadvantages: OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page already marks the gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 snapshot itself as 'Deprecated' in its list of snapshots and aliases.

OpenAI is winding down its fine-tuning platform: it is closed to new users, though existing users can still create jobs for a limited time, and inference on already fine-tuned models continues only until the base model is deprecated (OpenAI's supervised fine-tuning guide).
OpenAI's deprecations page schedules gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 and its fine-tuned models for shutdown on October 23, 2026, with gpt-5.6-terra listed as the recommended replacement base model.
Text-only input and output with no image, audio, or video support, and a September 1, 2021 knowledge cutoff (OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page).
use_cases: Continued inference on chat models already fine-tuned from gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 before OpenAI closed the fine-tuning platform to new users.
Supervised fine-tuning to generate content in a specific format.
Supervised fine-tuning to correct instruction-following failures.

notes: OpenAI does not publish a separate docs page for the gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 snapshot on its own (that URL 404s); it is documented as an entry in the GPT-3.5 Turbo model page's snapshots list and in the deprecations page, both cited above. OpenAI's example fine-tuned checkpoint id, 'ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0125:my-org:custom-suffix:96olL566:ckpt-step-2000', confirms this exact prefix format. Catalog facts (16,385 max input, 4,096 max output, text-only modality, 2026-10-23 deprecation, /v1/chat/completions endpoint) match OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo model page and deprecations page, and are identical to the plain 'ft:gpt-3.5-turbo' target since both currently name the same underlying snapshot. Web search was unavailable for this session (budget exhausted), so research relied on directly fetching OpenAI's own docs pages.
